_note: Voice for each speaker's impersonated clips (tools/generate_voice_clips.py). Keys are cast ids from cast.json (or a literal speaker label such as the landing's first mate). "ref": a reference recording of that person (6-30 s of clean speech) under art/voice_refs/; "builtin": one of XTTS-v2's built-in studio voices, for characters who aren't real people. Speakers with neither are spoken with system text-to-speech.
